newsitem.title: UK: Queen Elizabeth plans big golden wedding party.
newsitem.headline: Queen Elizabeth plans big golden wedding party.

text.p: Britain's Queen Elizabeth and her husband Prince Philip are planning to hold a golden wedding party inviting 4,000 other couples who also married in 1947, British newspapers reported on Tuesday.

The Daily Telegraph said ballots were being organised to choose couples from more than 100,000 marriages in the same year as the royal wedding. It said central records for such marriages were not held and couples would need to apply to attend.
A Buckingham Palace garden party is planned for July 15 to celebrate the event, the Telegraph reported.
